summary: Thomson Reuters filed a 6-K furnished with a news release announcing shareholder approval of a plan of arrangement for a return of capital and share consolidation. The special cash distribution totals US$605 million, approximately US$1.36 per share. A proportional reverse stock split will occur. The arrangement requires final court approval on April 29, 2026, and TSX/Nasdaq clearance. Effective May 4, 2026, with post-consolidation shares trading under a new CUSIP. Shareholders could opt out by April 27 deadline. Watch for court order and trading adjustments.
